sections.text:
- Watchdog severity=none This is an alert meant to ensure that the entire alerting pipeline is functional.
This alert is always firing, therefore it should always be firing in Alertmanager
and always fire against a receiver. There are integrations with various notification
mechanisms that send a notification when this alert is not firing. For example the
"DeadMansSnitch" integration in PagerDuty.

- PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers severity=warning Prometheus prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is not connected to any Alertmanagers.

parsed.root_cause: Chaos Mesh 執行的網路隔離實驗導致服務間通訊中斷，引發高延遲與錯誤率
evidence: Kubernetes events 顯示 chaos-mesh 的 NetworkChaos 資源 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-b7wl4' 在事故發生前被啟動並執行
告警顯示 otel-demo 命名空間內的 checkout、shipping、frontend-proxy 等服務出現極端延遲（超過 5-9 秒）及高錯誤率
KubeSchedulerDown 和 KubeControllerManagerDown 告警可能是由於控制平面節點因網路隔離或資源爭用而無法被 Prometheus 監控到
